exposure: Patients were stratified according to CL.
cohort: 61 patients diagnosed with anterior placenta previa/percreta prenatally who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at a tertiary care institution between 2004 and 2014
finding: Shorter cervical length (CL) was associated with increased difficulty during peripartum hysterectomy for placenta previa/percreta, as evidenced by longer operation times and increased blood transfusions.
